caption:
Caledon new build. Miss this form?

Tarion says buyers of a new home in Ontario can use two key warranty forms. 1) Send the 30-Day Form during the first 30 days of possession. 2) Only one 30-Day Form is accepted, so list every unresolved item you have found. 3) Send the Year-End Form during the last 30 days of the first year of possession; Tarion calls it your final opportunity to report items covered by the one-year warranty. 4) Filing either form starts a 120-day builder repair period, so keep dated photos and copies. Your exact deadlines depend on your possession date.
Source: Tarion, "How to make a warranty claim and what to expect" (tarion.com), checked Nov 22, 2026.

Milton lowball offer. Ignore it?

A low offer is not the end of the conversation. 1) Look past the price: the deposit, closing date and conditions count too. 2) Ask your Realtor® to compare it with recent sold prices of similar homes nearby. 3) A counter-offer lets you change the price, dates and terms. 4) Check how long the offer stays open before you reply. $1M Brampton home. What is the monthly mortgage?

Example only, computed with Canadian semi-annual compounding:
1) 20% down on $1,000,000 = $200,000.
2) Mortgage = $1,000,000 - $200,000 = $800,000.
3) At 4.64% over a 25-year amortization, the monthly mortgage is about $4,490.
That is the mortgage only: property tax, home insurance, utilities and maintenance are extra. 4.64% is nesto.ca's lowest 5-year fixed rate for 75-80% loan-to-value as of Nov 20, 2026; your rate depends on your lender and profile, and rates change at renewal. Lenders also apply the stress test, so what you can afford is not the same as what you qualify for.

caption:
Moved to Oakville? Six-day clock.

The Government of Ontario says you must update your driver's licence and vehicle permit within 6 days of your address changing, and your health card within 30 days. 1) Update your driver's licence and vehicle permit address within 6 days; it is free online through a ServiceOntario account. 2) Update your health card address within 30 days. 3) Your new vehicle permit is picked up at a ServiceOntario centre, so bring the old one. 4) Then tell your bank, insurer and employer.
Source: Government of Ontario, "Change my address: Ontario services" (ontario.ca), checked Nov 22, 2026.

caption:
5-year mortgage. Paid off in five?

Not quite. The Financial Consumer Agency of Canada says the mortgage term is the time your mortgage contract is in effect, while the amortization period is the time it takes to pay off the mortgage. 1) A 5-year term does not mean a 5-year payoff. 2) At the end of each term you renew. 3) Amortization is often 25 years; with less than 20% down the maximum is 30 years for first-time buyers or new builds, and 25 years in other cases. 4) Your rate can change at renewal, so compare options before your term ends.
Source: Financial Consumer Agency of Canada, "Mortgage terms and amortization" (canada.ca), checked Nov 22, 2026.

Georgetown basement. Radon tested?

Quick tip: radon is a radioactive gas you cannot see, smell or taste. Health Canada's guideline is 200 Bq/m³ and recommends a long-term test of at least three months, ideally in the fall or winter, placed in the lowest level where you spend time. Ask the seller if the home has ever been tested, and ask your Realtor® or home inspector how to arrange a test.
Source: Health Canada, "Radon: what you need to know" and "Radon reduction guide for Canadians" (canada.ca), checked Nov 22, 2026.
